api.title: Calling the API with a key
api.intro: Base URL: {{base}}. Send the key as a Bearer token on every request; the X-Api-Key header is not supported.
api.scopes: Scopes are CRM permissions (crm.*). Administration permissions (org.*) and approval decisions cannot be given; a key can never do more than its creator.
api.lifetime: Every key has an expiry date (at most {{max}} days); a revoked key stops at once.
api.rateLimit: {{limit}} requests per minute per key; beyond that the API answers 429 with a Retry-After header.
api.actAsCreator: A key acts on behalf of the user who created it: if the user is deactivated or loses permissions, the key narrows with them.

conventions.title: Paging, filters and errors
conventions.paging: Lists take page (from 1), pageSize (default 25, at most 100), sort (field or -field) and q (partial search); the answer is { items, page, pageSize, totalCount }. Timestamps are UTC ISO 8601, day fields are YYYY-MM-DD, amounts are numbers plus a currency.
conventions.errors: Errors are ProblemDetails; clients should act on the code field rather than the title. A concurrency conflict is 409 general.concurrency_conflict, the rate limit is 429.
conventions.versioning: The v1 contract only grows by addition (new endpoint, new optional field, new enum value); clients must ignore unknown fields and values. Breaking changes arrive as /api/v2; deprecated endpoints are announced with Deprecation and Sunset headers at least 6 months ahead (12 months for versions).

webhooks.title: Webhook guide
webhooks.intro: When an event happens the CRM sends a signed POST request to the HTTPS address you chose. A 2xx answer counts as success; the content carries no personal data (only ids, numbers, status and amounts), so fetch details from the API with a key.
webhooks.versionPolicy: The version in the envelope is per type. Fields of a type are never removed or renamed, only optional fields are added. A breaking change arrives as a new type name and the old type is delivered in parallel for at least 6 months.

headerDescriptions.eventId: Event id (the same for every attempt and resend); use it to de-duplicate

webhooks.signatureRule: v1 = HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>." + raw body), lowercase hex. The secret string (including the whsec_ prefix) is used as UTF-8. |now - t| must be at most {{seconds}} s; compare the v1 values in constant time. While a secret rotation is in its grace period the header holds two v1 values: accept the request if either matches.
webhooks.retry: A failed delivery is tried at most {{attempts}} times (after 10 s, 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h, 12 h; about 20 hours). The timeout is {{timeout}} s. 408, 425, 429 and 5xx are retried; other 4xx and redirects (3xx) are not. Results are kept for {{days}} days and can be resent from the delivery log.
webhooks.dedupe: Delivery is at least once: the same event can arrive more than once. Store X-Crm-Event-Id for at least 24 hours and ignore repeats; there is no ordering guarantee.
webhooks.unknownFields: Ignore unknown fields and enum values.
webhooks.network: The address must be HTTPS and reach a public domain name: private network addresses and IP addresses are blocked, redirects are not followed.
webhooks.fetchDetails: Fetch the record details from the API with an API key, using the ids in the envelope.
